provenance.notes: Debian slim images ship no man pages, so the flag list was read from GNU --help, which is complete by GNU convention. An earlier knowledge-written revision of this file omitted --zero (added in coreutils 8.25); it was found by diffing against this reference and is the reason provenance is now mandatory.

description: List information about the FILEs (the current directory by default). Entries are sorted alphabetically unless one of -cftuvSUX or --sort is given.
